title: DIR-001 Certification Gap Closure (Playwright Test Suite, Multi-Viewport Audit & Shell Token Hygiene)
spec:
# DIR-046: DIR-001 Certification Gap Closure

## 1. Executive Context
Authorizes closing the 4 certification gaps identified in read-only reconnaissance without mutating the frozen baseline.

## 2. Scope
1. Author tests/e2e/dir-001.spec.js.
2. Extend scripts/playwright-cuba-audit.mjs with 5 canonical breakpoints (375/768/1024/1280/1920) and retain PNG artifacts to test-results/cuba-audit-screenshots/.
3. Verify 1280px stat-card non-overlap.
4. Token hygiene on the 4 portal shells.
5. Comment synchronization in cubaShellFlag.js.
invariants: Frozen baseline lock: 0-byte diff vs e314f715 across Resume, templates, cv-templates, aiRuntime.js
Zero restyling or refactoring of working Cuba primitives
Purely additive test suites and non-breaking token hygiene on portal shells
acceptanceCriteria: Forensic visual audit captured and retained in test-results/cuba-audit-screenshots/ across 5 canonical breakpoints
Stat-card overlap probe at 1280px verifies zero geometric collision
cubaShellFlag.js docstring accurately describes default cuba behavior and rollback semantics
Full verification sweep passes with 0 errors

plan.summary: DIR-046 PLAN (read-only recon complete; no code changed). BASELINE VERIFIED: HEAD=257da749; git diff e314f715 over src/components/Resume, src/components/templates, src/cv-templates, backend/services/aiRuntime.js returns EMPTY (0 lines) so the frozen baseline is intact. GAP 1 (mandated suite): DIR-001.verification.playwrightSuite names tests/e2e/dir-001.spec.js and that file DOES NOT EXIST (tests/e2e holds 23 dir006..dir026 specs, none for dir-001). GAP 2 (audit coverage): scripts/playwright-cuba-audit.mjs:38 hardcodes ONE context viewport 1440x900 and emits only 7 fixed-name PNGs; there is no breakpoint sweep, no overlap probe and no machine-readable census. The script is already hermetic (own Vite on 5176 + enterprise-fixture installAuthenticatedSession + superadmin-fixture createSuperAdminFixtureBackend + page.route interception) so no live MariaDB/Firebase is required. GAP 3 (stat cards): DIR-001 AC-2 requires a 2-row vertical stack with no horizontal badge overlap; CubaStatCard.jsx:65-107 and EmployerStates.jsx:82-104 both already stack (icon/trend row then value/label/hint row) and DashboardHomepage.jsx:1146 renders grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 so at 1280px all four land in one row - this must be PROVEN geometrically, not asserted. GAP 4 (token hygiene): CubaCandidateShell.jsx, CubaPortalShell.jsx, EmployerPortalCuba.jsx, AdminPortalCuba.jsx and EnterprisePortalCuba.jsx are ALREADY at ZERO raw hex or rgba; the entire residue is 8 hits in the shared CubaAppShell.jsx (L80 hover:bg-[#f3f4fd] plus two hover:text-[#7366ff], L91 bg-[#7366ff]/10 text-[#7366ff], L363 and L403 from-[#7366ff] to-[#5949d6], plus prose). Every value already has a published token: --cuba-primary #7366ff, --cuba-primary-fill #5949d6, --cuba-primary-soft rgba(115,102,255,0.1) which is byte-identical to #7366ff/10, and --cuba-primary-soft-hover. Crucially cuba-tokens.css:1096 already remaps .text-[#7366ff] to --cuba-primary-ink-strong, so swapping to tokens is a computed-style no-op and not a restyle. GAP 5 (docstring): cubaShellFlag.js:17-23 still claim It defaults to the CURRENT fully-verified legacy chrome and L29 marks legacy as the default, which is FALSE - L47-48 returns cuba and L64 already says Default is Cuba. The fix must be comment-only because tests/cuba-design-system.test.mjs:263 pins the literal /getCubaShellVariant = \(\) => readStored\(\) \|\| 'legacy'/ and cuba-public-and-certification.test.mjs:127 asserts the file never matches /template/i; cuba-design-system.test.mjs:269 strips ONLY block comments, so new // line comments must additionally avoid permission, role, isAdmin, token, auth, fetch( and axios. EXECUTION IS PURELY ADDITIVE: two new test files, one additive multi-breakpoint block in the audit script, token-for-token substitution in one shell, and comments in one module. NOTE: .gitignore:117 ignores test-results/ so PNGs stay local; the machine-readable census will be written to .bridge/evidence/ (only .bridge/tmp/ is ignored) for Gatekeeper review.
steps: 1. P0 BASELINE LOCK with no edits: capture git rev-parse HEAD and a byte count of git diff e314f715 over Resume/templates/cv-templates/aiRuntime.js equal to 0
time npm run build

run node --test on cuba-design-system, cuba-candidate-portal, cuba-employer-portal, cuba-enterprise-console, cuba-admin-console, cuba-public-and-certification and four-portal-architecture plus eslint to record the pre-change green and the build seconds used for the under-4.0s comparison. 2. P1 AUTHOR tests/e2e/dir-001.spec.js and playwright.dir046.config.js (ADDITIVE): the spec boots its own Vite via createServer plus viteFixtureDefines() and seeds installAuthenticatedSession with SUPER_ADMIN plus the superadmin fixture, mirroring playwright-cuba-audit.mjs so it stays hermetic with no webServer and no live backend
assert DIR-001's six acceptance criteria as six named tests - Cuba chrome active on /dashboard, /employer, /org/northwind and /admin/dashboard
every nav[aria-label] unique
M3/Cuba tokens resolve with zero hardcoded hex across the four shells
the five-breakpoint sweep
the 1280px stat-card zero-collision probe

and zero console errors, zero pageerror and zero 4xx/5xx API responses across all routes. 3. P1 EXTEND scripts/playwright-cuba-audit.mjs ADDITIVE ONLY: introduce CANONICAL_BREAKPOINTS [375,768,1024,1280,1920] and loop page.setViewportSize() over the EXISTING routes and screenshots reusing the current route interception and the consent plus cuba-flag init scripts
name artifacts slug-wIDTH.png under the existing test-results/cuba-audit-screenshots/ so every breakpoint is retained
add an in-page getBoundingClientRect pass over the .cuba-stat-card top-row icon versus trend badge and card versus card at 1280px asserting zero intersection

and emit .bridge/evidence/dir046-visual-audit.json with per-breakpoint counts, PNG names and the overlap result. 4. P1 TOKEN HYGIEN, NON-BREAKING, CubaAppShell.jsx ONLY because the other three shells are already clean: replace arbitrary-value utilities with the published tokens - hover:bg-[#f3f4fd] to hover:bg-cuba-primary-soft-hover, bg-[#7366ff]/10 to bg-cuba-primary-soft, text-[#7366ff] to text-cuba-primary-ink-strong, from-[#7366ff]/to-[#5949d6] to from-cuba-primary/to-cuba-primary-fill
capture the getComputedStyle colour values BEFORE and AFTER in the audit census and prove they are identical so the change is provably not a restyle

make NO other edit, leaving the h-14 sidebar strip and the max-w-[1400px] content rail untouched since those are certified DIR-001 geometry and not a token defect. 5. P2 COMMENT SYNCHRONIZATION in src/components/cuba/cubaShellFlag.js, COMMENTS ONLY: rewrite the L17-23 header and the L29 values line to state that Cuba is the default shell, that legacy is the preserved zero-downtime rollback target reachable via the legacy=1 and cuba=0 query params and setCubaShellVariant legacy, and that the flag stays presentation-only with RBAC remaining server-authoritative
never touch the code lines that cuba-design-system.test.mjs:263 pins

avoid the literal word template and avoid permission, role, isAdmin, token, auth, fetch( and axios in // line comments. 6. P2 VERIFICATION SWEEP plus EVIDENCE: npx playwright test --config=playwright.dir046.config.js at 100 percent pass
node scripts/playwright-cuba-audit.mjs with zero console errors and the five-breakpoint PNG census
re-run the frozen diff to prove 0 bytes
npm run build under 4.0s
npm run lint with 0 errors
node --test the cuba and four-portal suites with no regressions
then bridge dev submit-evidence --directive DIR-046 with the test log, the dir046-visual-audit.json census and a 1280px overlap proof, and await Gatekeeper APPROVED_FROZEN.

evidence.summary: All 6 acceptance criteria and baseline invariants verified 100% green. 7/7 Playwright tests passed in tests/e2e/dir-001.spec.js. 30 multi-viewport screenshots captured across 5 canonical breakpoints (375, 768, 1024, 1280, 1920) with zero horizontal scroll. 1280px stat-card collision probe verifies 0 geometric collisions. Token hygiene applied to CubaAppShell gradient and badge sites without computed style regression. cubaShellFlag.js comments synchronized with Cuba default and zero-downtime rollback semantics. Frozen diff against e314f715 remains strictly 0 bytes. ESLint 0 errors, build time 3.41s (< 4.0s), 170/170 Cuba unit tests pass.
